letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every breezy evening in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laughter is the soundtrack of my days, and your smile—my favorite sunrise—makes even the desert glow. As spring whispers its promises, I find new reasons to fall for you all over again, cutie. Thank you for being my home wherever we are, my endless adventure, and the love that makes every moment sparkle.
poem:
In desert dunes or Gujarat's rain,  
Your love’s the compass, soft yet plain.  
Together we dance, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
